notes.title: Political Machine 2016 v1.33 Update
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10854522/4fa25baf0a96a366b6a7760e322a780883ffe872.png[/img]

We are almost to election day. It seemed like Hillary might coast to victory, but the recent batch of emails may knock her out. We've updated issues and introduced some new random events to reflect the world. Read below for details!

[h1]Change Log[/h1]
[b]Issues Updates[/b]
[i]Election Integrity (New)[/i] Politicians on both sides are questioning the validity of election results, suspect either vote tampering or voter suppression. This issue is especially important to Trump. 

[i]Probing Hillary's Emails (updated)[/i]. The FBI's eleventh-hour revelation of new emails has added to the campaign chaos and increasing awareness of this issue. 


[b]New random events[/b]
[i]Internet Revelations[/i]
Whether it was hackers or cyber-punks or just troublesome teens, someone has been breaking into emails and sharing secrets with the world, causing an unneeded distraction at this critical stage in the campaign. Reduces a candidate's credibility with voters. 

[i]Foreign Interference[/i]
Foreign powers have developed a sudden interest in American democracy and seeing specific candidate win. This has raised questions about the integrity of our democracy. This event reduces a candidate's ability to raise money; it also raises the importance of the "Nationalism" and of "Election Integrity" issues. 

[i]Internal Party Revolt[/i]
Both political parties have rebels stirring in revolt against their candidate, questioning everything they do, said they'll do, or quietly bragged about doing. Reduces a candidate's support across the board.

notes.title: Political Machine 2016 v1.31 Released
notes.content:
The last few weeks in the political world have been crazy. Based on the recent debates and real-life events, we've decided to update the game's issues and introduced a new debate-themed random event. Read below for details!
[b][/b]
[h1]Change Log[/h1]
[b]Issues Updates:[/b]
[*]Increased the importance of "Probing Hillary's emails." This remains one of the greatest weak spots in Hillary's campaign. [*]Increased raised the importance of "Tax cuts" as there is increasing pressure for Trump to release his tax returns. [*]Slightly reduced the importance of "Fighting ISIS"[*]Slightly reduced the importance of "Securing the Borders." [*]Both of these latter two issues are still important to many voters. However, as other issues have been consuming more time, there has been less focus on them. [/list]

[b]New random event "Debate Disaster"[/b] [list][*]Your debate performance has led to some uncomfortable gaffes related to taxes and led to speculations on whether you were under the influence. [*]Reduces your credibility, increase the importance of "War on Drugs" and "Tax Cuts."[/list]

notes.title: The Political Machine 2016's latest update brings in the VPs
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10854522/7fe032ec34523f31df32a94cf74461660729eb21.png[/img]

Stardock has updated its popular strategy game, The Political Machine 2016 with new issues and new candidates to run with including Jill Stein, Bill Weld and Tim Kaine.  In addition, new issues like the National Anthem protest have also been added into the game’s simulation.

In The Political Machine, you run for President of the United States. You can run using existing candidates such as Donald Trump or Hillary Clinton or create your candidate.  One recent update allows you to simulate an actual election with the AI running each candidate’s campaign to see how well they do. 

The simulation’s top issues for 2016, according to the Trump AI are Securing the Borders, Attacking Mrs. Clinton’s email handling and preventing domestic terrorism.  For Clinton AI, it’s Reducing the wealth gap, Attacking Trump’s Erratic positions, and reducing health care costs.  Of course, that’s only what the computer AI thinks they should do.

“Based on the simulation, it could go either way,” said lead designer, Brad Wardell. “I know that’s a cop out but the AI players tend to run the campaigns slightly more optimally than the real thing. They never go off message and they don’t make mistakes in simulation mode.”

Players can play against the computer AI at different levels of difficulty as well against their friends on the Internet or pick two candidates and have the AI control them to see who would win under various circumstances.

Its home page is [url=http://www.politicalmachine.com]www.politicalmachine.com[/url] and can be purchased on [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/404620/]Steam[/url] for only $9.99.

You can see the full changelog here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/404620/discussions/0/343786746016733029/

notes.title: New Campaign DLC for The Political Machine 2016 is Now Available
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10854522/b16cbc4d6c772e3180aa3219739869a29fe8f79b.png[/img]

[h1]New Campaign DLC brings Ladder Mode, Historical Candidates, and New Challenges[/h1]
Battle for your spot in the White House against some of the most famous (and infamous!) presidents in American history. 

[b]New Ladder Mode [/b]
Democrat or Republican? Choose your side and take the nation by storm as you campaign against members of the opposite party to win the presidency. Don’t let your victories go to your head, though - each new opponent will prove more difficult than the last. No one ever said winning the election would be easy!

[b]New Historical Candidates[/b]
Race against several historical presidents of the past and claim your victory against them. Each candidate comes with a modern perspective on all of the hot current issues and is ready to fight for the 2016 presidency. Defeat each candidate to unlock them for general gameplay.

[b]New Challenges [/b]
Elections are unpredictable, so each ladder-mode match includes a custom challenge. Things like dealing with high gas prices, the people’s mistrust of politicians, impending war, and more will keep you on your toes as you try to make your opponent’s campaign points a forgotten memory.
 	 
Get the Campaign DLC now on [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/495380/]Steam[/url] or through [url=https://store.stardock.com/cart/add/ESD-SDE-W123]Stardock[/url]!

For more information, visit www.politicalmachine.com

notes.title: The Political Machine 2016 v1.2 - Available Now
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10854522/287a459b657c9e3dbcede793896a86f4e93db6d1.png[/img]

[h1]v1.2 Brings Ranked Multiplayer Matchmaking, Election Simulation Mode and a New Campaign Event[/h1]

Enjoy spectating two candidates of your choice battling it out, match up against other players of your skill level online, and test your wits against a new event in v1.2.
 
[b]Ranked Multiplayer Matchmaking[/b]
Looking for someone to play? The new matchmaking system will pair you with someone of similar skill. Your rank increases as you win and you'll be matched with more challenging opponents.	

[b]Election Simulation Mode [/b]
Hillary or Trump? Sanders or Johnson? If you want to really know who is the better candidate enable "simulation" and watch them battle it out.
 	 
v1.2 also brings the new "Brexit" event. How will you respond to an issue that is resonating in the hearts and minds of the American people? To learn more about the update and everything else we've added, check out the full changelog at the bottom of the post.

notes.content:

do whatever it takes to become the President of the United States! [/h1]

If you've ever watched the U.S. elections and thought to yourself, "Even I can do better than that!" -- well, this is the game for you! Take to the campaign trail and win the hearts and minds of America's voters to take your place in the White House.

notes.title: Turn Your Friends into Frenemies - Multiplayer is Now Available in v.80!
notes.content:
[b]Climb to the Top of Capitol Hill... [/b][b]Watch your Friends Roll Down to the Bottom![/b]

Multiplayer has arrived - Check the Full Changelog Below

You asked for it, so here it is: the chance to stampede over your friends' campaigns and become the new President of the United States of America! v.80 is now here with the new "multiplayer" option, complete with lobby and in-game chat so that you can sling mud at each other throughout the course of your campaigns.This update also includes some new issues that reflect current national and international events, and some graphical stability fixes. Take a look at the complete change log for more details on the new additions.Happy (Campaign) Trails to you!

[h1]CHANGE LOG[/h1]

[b]Major Changes[/b][list][*][b]Multiplayer:[/b]  Battle for the White House against your friends[*][b]Updated Issues:[/b]  Adjusted the importance of issues to better reflect current events[*][b]Stability:[/b] Addressed numerous graphical issues including problems with the mouse cursor[/list][b]Issues[/b][list][*]Most issue values have been changed.  Of particular note are Fighting Issues, Immigration, and A Stronger Military are now top issues  [*]Added more variety to issue importance[*]Adjusted some issue names to make them sound more neutral   [/list][b]Graphics[/b][list][*]"Use Hardware Cursor" will no longer make the cursor invisible[*]Mouse cursor is now DPI aware.  This should address problems where the mouse pointer was offset from the mouse or moved a different speed[*]Added support for higher resolution monitors[*]Added a "Fullscreen" choice in the resolution spinner control on the Options Window[*]"Options" window will wait to warn you about needing a restart until you leave the options window, rather than warning you as soon as you change an option that would require a restart[*]Fixed z-order issue that was causing the characteristics/issues section of the "Choose Candidate" window to not show up for opponents[*]When playing in windowed mode, the game will remember its window position next time you start[/list][b]Bugs[/b][list][*]Disabled action buttons when you cannot perform them (ie. not enough stamina/money/clout/etc), and tool tips explain why.[*]Added "War on Drugs" icon[*]Added specific images for the "War on Drugs"[*]Fixed issue on the "World Setup" window where the slider description would not always match the slider you are modifying[*]Took some text out of the 60 Seconds background image referring to the Election 'Wrapping Up'[*]Changed the text color on the "Exit Polls" window so that it's more readable against a red or blue background[*]Main screen: The "state awareness" text will no longer be clipped if either or both candidate reaches 100% awareness[*]Main screen: Replaced the "Special Interest" button with "Endorsements" and "Operatives" buttons[*]Main screen: Switched functionality and fixed the "Assets" button and "Candidate Info" buttons[*]Changed the highlight color of first/last name controls on "New Candidate" window from black to gray[*]Fixed a stray bobblehead that would show up behind the "World Setup" Window[*]The "Party" sort button is hidden when choosing a running mate since all candidates shown will match your party[*]When "time in game" updates mins or hours, if you are on the Title Window, it'll update its text display of time played[/list]
